model-value.desc: Model of the component defining shown/hidden state; Use with v-model

target.desc: Configure a target element to trigger component toggle; 'true' enables the parent DOM element

context-menu.desc: Opens with a right mouse click (or long tap on mobile)

fit.desc: Allows the menu to match at least the full width of its target

cover.desc: Allows the menu to cover its target. When used, 'self' and 'fit' are no longer effective

anchor.desc: Starting position of the menu relative to its target

self.desc: Menu's own position relative to its target

offset.desc: An array of two numbers to offset the menu horizontally and vertically in pixels

persistent.desc: Menu won't be dismissed by click/tap outside or ESC key

no-esc-dismiss.desc: User cannot dismiss the popup by hitting ESC key

auto-close.desc: Any click/tap in the menu closes it; Useful instead of v-close-popup on each item

touch-position.desc: Menu position set by the mouse/touch position when target is clicked

square.desc: Forces content to have squared borders

max-height.desc: The maximum height of the menu; Size in CSS units

max-width.desc: The maximum width of the menu; Size in CSS units

transition-show.desc: One of Quasar's embedded transitions for showing

transition-hide.desc: One of Quasar's embedded transitions for hiding

dark.desc: Notify the component that the background is a dark color

separate-close-popup.desc: Separate from parent menu, marking it as a separate closing point for v-close-popup

default.desc: Default slot for the menu content

update:model-value.desc: Emitted when shown/hidden state changes; Used by v-model

show.desc: Emitted after component has triggered show()

before-show.desc: Emitted when component triggers show() but before it finishes

hide.desc: Emitted after component has triggered hide()

before-hide.desc: Emitted when component triggers hide() but before it finishes

escape-key.desc: Emitted when ESC key is pressed; Not emitted if 'persistent' or 'no-esc-dismiss' is set

toggle.desc: Triggers component to toggle between show/hide

focus.desc: Focus menu; if content has autofocus attribute, it will directly focus it
